enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Place right arm under pillow. Turn to right side. Kick left leg out from under blanket. Adjust pillow with left hand. Snore. Turn onto stomach. Move right arm. Scratch left cheek. Yawn. Stretch arms. Continue sleeping.
Open eyes. Sit up. Reach for phone. Pick up phone. Press power button. Look at screen. Swipe to unlock. Check messages. Open news app. Scroll. Put phone down. Swing legs out of bed.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Splash water on face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour milk into bowl. Stir. Pour mixture into pan. Cook. Flip. Turn off stove. Place on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Open backpack. Put in laptop. Put in charger. Put in notebook. Zip backpack. Pick up backpack.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on badge. Walk to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Answer phone. Attend meeting. Take lunch break. Eat sandwich. Return to work. Check emails. Complete paperwork. Handover to next shift.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Take off shoes. Put down bag. Walk to bedroom. Change clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Take out pan. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add water. Chop vegetables. Add chicken to pan. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Browse channels. Stop on news. Watch. Adjust volume. Put feet on table. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit. Eat snack. Continue watching.

Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Navigate to website. Watch video. Scroll. Open game. Play game. Use keyboard. Use mouse. Take break. Get water. Return. Close game. Open email. Read. Close laptop.

Pick up book. Open to page. Read. Turn page. Read. Adjust lamp. Read. Turn page. Read. Put bookmark. Close book. Stand up. Stretch. Walk to bookshelf. Put book away. Pick up magazine. Return to seat. Open magazine. Read.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Open video. Watch. Open messaging app. Send text. Read reply. Close app. Place phone on nightstand. Pick up book. Read. Put book down. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to side. Breathe. Snore. Turn to other side. Move arm. Scratch leg. Yawn. Continue sleeping.
